problemStatement: src/math.js exports add(a, b) which returns a + b + 1 instead of a + b. Fix it so add(2, 3) returns 5 and add(-1, 1) returns 0.

function add(a, b) { return a + b + 1; }
module.exports = { add };

problemStatement: src/slug.js must export slugify(s) that converts a title to a URL slug: lowercase, runs of non-alphanumeric characters collapse to single hyphens, no leading or trailing hyphens. slugify('Hello World!') returns 'hello-world'; slugify('A_B  C') returns 'a-b-c'; slugify('  --x--  ') returns 'x'.

files.src/slug.js:
function slugify(s) { return String(s); }
module.exports = { slugify };

problemStatement: src/parse.js exports parseJsonl(text) which throws when the input contains blank lines or a trailing newline. Fix it to skip blank/whitespace-only lines and return the parsed objects.
src/clamp.js exports clamp(v, lo, hi) which must bound v to [lo, hi]. It currently returns v unchanged. Fix it: clamp(5, 0, 3) returns 3, clamp(-1, 0, 3) returns 0, clamp(2, 0, 3) returns 2.

files.src/clamp.js:
function clamp(v, lo, hi) { return v; }
module.exports = { clamp };

problemStatement: src/lines.js exports countLines(text) that counts the number of lines. It over-counts by one whenever the text ends with a newline. countLines('a\nb\n') must return 2, countLines('a') returns 1, countLines('') returns 0.

files.src/lines.js:
function countLines(text) { return String(text).split('\n').length; }
module.exports = { countLines };
